children: RiverNorth Opportunities Fund entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue 3,000,000 shares of Series B Mandatory Redeemable Preferred Stock at a $25 liquidation preference, raising approximately $75 million. The MRP Shares carry a 6.476% annual dividend, paid monthly, and are mandatorily redeemable on September 18, 2031. Proceeds will be used to refinance existing debt and fund new portfolio investments. The offering was conducted as a private placement under Rule 506(b).
